arStrings.szText: "How are you going to deal with Marcellus?"
That depends. How do you feel about fist-fighting a Morlu?
See that portly fellow over there? The one who looks like he hasn't slept in a week? That's Cleon.
I want you to pose as a drifter and offer to fight as his champion. If he takes the bait, Cleon should lead us directly to Marcellus. My soldiers and I will do the rest.
Just act natural. I'm sure you'll do fine.
